blocks.html: The aging process might be inevitable, but looking older than you feel certainly doesn’t have to be. The talented skin care professionals at the Victory MedSpa offer PDO threading — an innovative, nonsurgical facelift that rejuvenates and regenerates your skin in about an hour. Learn more about this cutting-edge treatment for a younger, firmer, wrinkle-minimizing appearance by calling the experts at the Victory MedSpa today!

Polydioxanone (PDO) threading is a nonsurgical treatment commonly used to rejuvenate sagging facial skin. During this procedure, one of the experienced practitioners on the Victory Medical team injects special surgical-grade threads into your skin with a fine needle.
The thread is made from polydioxanone — a material that has been used for medical sutures for more than 35 years.
The PDO thread lift skin tissue and improve texture. The threads also stimulate the production of new collagen, so your skin continues to lift and rejuvenate in the weeks following the procedure.
Your body absorbs the thread as it dissolves and eliminates it naturally.

The minimally-invasive PDO threading treatment involves injecting tiny threads into the deeper layers under the surface of your skin. There is some discomfort during this procedure, but it’s usually well-tolerated. You may request a topical numbing agent to help minimize any discomfort.

Once the threads are in place, they lift your face upward, giving the appearance of firmer skin. The PDO threads also promote cellular renewal through collagen stimulation, which improves your skin’s texture and elasticity, and diminishes fine lines. This treatment also contracts fatty tissue under your skin, making it appear tighter.
After the threads dissolve and your body eliminates them, your skin continues to appear firmer, slimmer, and smoother for 6-9 months as a result of new collagen production.
